heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of showers and thunderstorms, a rising chance mid to late afternoon; a severe storm possible. Highs from the mid 70s to lower 80s. South winds 5 to 15 mph, and gusting to 20 mph, except gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy, with areas of valley fog late. Showers and thunderstorms likely; a severe storm possible early. Lows in the upper 50s to lower 60s. South winds 5 to 15 mph, becoming west and diminishing late.

heading: Friday
text: Areas of morning fog, then mostly to partly cloudy. Chance of showers, mainly from the Champlain Valley south and east; a rumble of thunder possible east of the Greens. Highs in the upper 70s to lower 80s, some lower 70s far north. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.
